meta.description: Definition of the base wgpu API, derived from 'webgpu.json', 'diff_base.json', 'diff_docs.json'.
meta.notes: The full API, including docs, in one file. This does *not* include enums/flags/structs from any of the backends.

MAP_READ.doc: The buffer can be mapped for reading by the CPU (see flags.MapMode.READ). Can only be combined with COPY_DST.

MAP_WRITE.doc: The buffer can be mapped for writing by the CPU (see flags.MapMode.WRITE). Can only be combined with COPY_SRC.

COPY_SRC.doc: The buffer can be the source of a copy operation, e.g. the source of GPUCommandEncoder.copy_buffer_to_buffer().

COPY_DST.doc: The buffer can be the destination of a copy or write operation, e.g. GPUQueue.write_buffer() or GPUCommandEncoder.clear_buffer().

INDEX.doc: The buffer can be used as an index buffer, see GPURenderCommandsMixin.set_index_buffer().

VERTEX.doc: The buffer can be used as a vertex buffer, see GPURenderCommandsMixin.set_vertex_buffer().

UNIFORM.doc: The buffer can be bound as a uniform buffer, see enums.BufferBindingType.uniform.

STORAGE.doc: The buffer can be bound as a storage buffer, see enums.BufferBindingType.storage.

INDIRECT.doc: The buffer can be used to source indirect draw or dispatch parameters, e.g. GPURenderCommandsMixin.draw_indirect().

QUERY_RESOLVE.doc: The buffer can be the destination of GPUCommandEncoder.resolve_query_set().

BufferUsage.doc:
Bit flags describing how a GPUBuffer can be used. Combine them with the bitwise OR operator.

The usage is set when creating the buffer (see the usage field of structs.BufferDescriptor) and cannot be changed afterwards.
Using a buffer in a way that was not declared here results in a validation error.

READ.doc: Map the buffer for reading. Requires the buffer to have flags.BufferUsage.MAP_READ.

WRITE.doc: Map the buffer for writing. Requires the buffer to have flags.BufferUsage.MAP_WRITE.

MapMode.doc:
Bit flags that specify whether a buffer is mapped for reading or writing.

Used in the mode argument of the GPUBuffer.map_async() method. The mode must match the
flags.BufferUsage of the buffer: READ requires flags.BufferUsage.MAP_READ, WRITE requires flags.BufferUsage.MAP_WRITE.

COPY_SRC.doc: The texture can be the source of a copy operation, e.g. GPUCommandEncoder.copy_texture_to_buffer().

COPY_DST.doc: The texture can be the destination of a copy or write operation, e.g. GPUQueue.write_texture().

TEXTURE_BINDING.doc: The texture can be bound for sampling in a shader, see structs.TextureBindingLayout.

STORAGE_BINDING.doc: The texture can be bound as a storage texture in a shader, see structs.StorageTextureBindingLayout.

RENDER_ATTACHMENT.doc: The texture can be used as a color or depth/stencil attachment in a render pass, see structs.RenderPassDescriptor.

TRANSIENT_ATTACHMENT.doc: The texture is a transient attachment: its contents only live for the duration of a render pass and may never be written to memory. Must be combined with RENDER_ATTACHMENT only, and used with enums.StoreOp.discard.

TextureUsage.doc:
Bit flags describing how a GPUTexture can be used. Combine them with the bitwise OR operator.

The usage is set when creating the texture (see the usage field of structs.TextureDescriptor).
Texture views can restrict the usage further (see the usage field of structs.TextureViewDescriptor).

ShaderStage.doc:
Bit flags that specify in which shader stages a resource is visible.

Used in the visibility field of structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry.

ALL.doc: Write all channels (RED, GREEN, BLUE and ALPHA).

ColorWrite.doc:
Bit flags that specify which color channels of a render target are written to.

Used in the write_mask field of structs.ColorTargetState.

low_power.doc: Prefer an adapter that uses little power, e.g. an integrated GPU.

high_performance.doc: Prefer an adapter with the highest performance, e.g. a discrete GPU.

core_features_and_limits.doc: Indicates that the adapter supports the core WebGPU features and limits (as opposed to compatibility mode).

depth_clip_control.doc: Allows disabling depth clipping, see the unclipped_depth field of structs.PrimitiveState.

texture_compression_bc.doc: Enables the BC (S3TC, RGTC, BPTC) compressed texture formats, e.g. enums.TextureFormat.bc1_rgba_unorm.

texture_compression_bc_sliced_d3.doc: Allows the BC compressed formats to be used with enums.TextureDimension.d3 textures. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

texture_compression_etc2.doc: Enables the ETC2 and EAC compressed texture formats, e.g. enums.TextureFormat.etc2_rgb8unorm.

texture_compression_astc.doc: Enables the ASTC compressed texture formats, e.g. enums.TextureFormat.astc_4x4_unorm.

texture_compression_astc_sliced_d3.doc: Allows the ASTC compressed formats to be used with enums.TextureDimension.d3 textures. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

timestamp_query.doc: Enables timestamp queries, see enums.QueryType.timestamp and structs.RenderPassTimestampWrites.

indirect_first_instance.doc: Allows a non-zero first_instance in indirect draw commands, e.g. GPURenderCommandsMixin.draw_indirect().

shader_f16.doc: Allows the use of the f16 type in WGSL shaders (the enable f16 directive).

rg11b10ufloat_renderable.doc: Allows enums.TextureFormat.rg11b10ufloat to be used as a render attachment, with blending and multisampling.

bgra8unorm_storage.doc: Allows enums.TextureFormat.bgra8unorm to be used as a storage texture.

float32_filterable.doc: Allows 32-bit float textures to be filtered, i.e. used with a filtering sampler.

float32_blendable.doc: Allows 32-bit float color attachments to be used with blending.

clip_distances.doc: Allows the clip_distances built-in in WGSL vertex shaders, for user-defined clip planes.

dual_source_blending.doc: Allows blending with a second fragment shader output, see enums.BlendFactor.src1.

subgroups.doc: Allows the use of subgroup operations in WGSL shaders.

texture_formats_tier1.doc: Enables additional texture format capabilities, including the 16-bit normalized formats (e.g. enums.TextureFormat.r16unorm), and more storage and render support for existing formats.

texture_formats_tier2.doc: Enables further texture format capabilities, such as read-write storage access for more formats. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

primitive_index.doc: Allows the primitive_index built-in in WGSL fragment shaders.

texture_component_swizzle.doc: Allows swizzling the components of a texture view, see the swizzle field of structs.TextureViewDescriptor.

FeatureName.doc:
Names of optional features that an adapter may support and a device may request.

Available features can be inspected via the features property of GPUAdapter. Features
are enabled by listing them in the required_features field of structs.DeviceDescriptor.
The features of the device are available via the features property of GPUDevice.

unmapped.doc: The buffer is not mapped; it can be used by the GPU.

pending.doc: A GPUBuffer.map_async() call is in progress but has not yet completed.

mapped.doc: The buffer is mapped and its memory can be accessed using GPUBuffer.get_mapped_range().

BufferMapState.doc: The mapping state of a GPUBuffer, available via the map_state property of GPUBuffer.

d1.doc: A one-dimensional texture, with only a width.

d2.doc: A two-dimensional texture, with width and height. Also used for 2D array textures and cube maps (via layers).

d3.doc: A three-dimensional (volume) texture, with width, height and depth.

TextureDimension.doc:
The dimensionality of a GPUTexture.

Used in the dimension field of structs.TextureDescriptor.

d1.doc: A one-dimensional view; corresponds to texture_1d in WGSL.

d2.doc: A two-dimensional view of a single layer; corresponds to texture_2d in WGSL.

d2_array.doc: A view of an array of 2D layers; corresponds to texture_2d_array in WGSL.

cube.doc: A cube map view consisting of six 2D layers; corresponds to texture_cube in WGSL.

cube_array.doc: A view of an array of cube maps (a multiple of six layers); corresponds to texture_cube_array in WGSL.

d3.doc: A three-dimensional view; corresponds to texture_3d in WGSL.

TextureViewDimension.doc:
The dimensionality of a GPUTextureView, i.e. how a texture is interpreted when bound to a shader.

Used in the dimension field of structs.TextureViewDescriptor and the view_dimension field of
structs.TextureBindingLayout and structs.StorageTextureBindingLayout.

all.doc: All available aspects of the texture format.

stencil_only.doc: Only the stencil aspect of a depth-stencil format.

depth_only.doc: Only the depth aspect of a depth-stencil format.

TextureAspect.doc:
Which aspect (part) of a texture a view or copy operation refers to.

This is mostly relevant for depth-stencil formats, which have separate depth and stencil aspects.

r16unorm.doc: One channel (red), 16-bit unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

r16snorm.doc: One channel (red), 16-bit signed normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

rg8unorm.doc: Two channels (red, green), 8-bit unsigned normalized each.

rg8snorm.doc: Two channels (red, green), 8-bit signed normalized each.

rg8uint.doc: Two channels (red, green), 8-bit unsigned integer each.

rg8sint.doc: Two channels (red, green), 8-bit signed integer each.

rg16unorm.doc: Two channels (red, green), 16-bit unsigned normalized each. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

rg16snorm.doc: Two channels (red, green), 16-bit signed normalized each. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

rg16uint.doc: Two channels (red, green), 16-bit unsigned integer each.

rg16sint.doc: Two channels (red, green), 16-bit signed integer each.

rg16float.doc: Two channels (red, green), 16-bit floating point each.

rgba8unorm.doc: Four channels (red, green, blue, alpha), 8-bit unsigned normalized each.

rgba8unorm_srgb.doc: Four channels (RGBA), 8-bit unsigned normalized each, with sRGB encoding of the color channels.

bgra8unorm.doc: Four channels in blue, green, red, alpha order, 8-bit unsigned normalized each. Often the preferred canvas format, see GPU.get_preferred_canvas_format().

bgra8unorm_srgb.doc: Four channels in BGRA order, 8-bit unsigned normalized each, with sRGB encoding of the color channels.

rgb9e5ufloat.doc: Packed 32-bit format with three 9-bit unsigned float mantissas (RGB) and a shared 5-bit exponent. Not renderable.

rgb10a2uint.doc: Packed 32-bit format with 10-bit unsigned integer RGB channels and a 2-bit unsigned integer alpha.

rgb10a2unorm.doc: Packed 32-bit format with 10-bit unsigned normalized RGB channels and a 2-bit unsigned normalized alpha.

rg11b10ufloat.doc: Packed 32-bit format with unsigned floating point R and G (11 bits each) and B (10 bits). Renderable only with enums.FeatureName.rg11b10ufloat_renderable.

rg32uint.doc: Two channels (red, green), 32-bit unsigned integer each.

rg32sint.doc: Two channels (red, green), 32-bit signed integer each.

rg32float.doc: Two channels (red, green), 32-bit floating point each.

rgba16unorm.doc: Four channels (RGBA), 16-bit unsigned normalized each. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

rgba16snorm.doc: Four channels (RGBA), 16-bit signed normalized each. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_formats_tier1.

stencil8.doc: A stencil-only format with 8 bits per pixel.

depth16unorm.doc: A depth-only format with 16-bit unsigned normalized depth.

depth24plus.doc: A depth-only format with at least 24 bits of depth. The exact representation is implementation-defined and cannot be copied to a buffer.

depth24plus_stencil8.doc: A depth-stencil format with at least 24 bits of depth and 8 bits of stencil. The depth aspect cannot be copied to a buffer.

depth32float.doc: A depth-only format with 32-bit floating point depth.

depth32float_stencil8.doc: A depth-stencil format with 32-bit floating point depth and 8 bits of stencil. Requires enums.FeatureName.depth32float_stencil8.

bc1_rgba_unorm.doc: BC1 (DXT1) compressed RGBA, unsigned normalized. 4x4 blocks of 8 bytes. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc1_rgba_unorm_srgb.doc: BC1 (DXT1) compressed RGBA with sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc2_rgba_unorm.doc: BC2 (DXT3) compressed RGBA, unsigned normalized. 4x4 blocks of 16 bytes. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc2_rgba_unorm_srgb.doc: BC2 (DXT3) compressed RGBA with sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc3_rgba_unorm.doc: BC3 (DXT5) compressed RGBA, unsigned normalized. 4x4 blocks of 16 bytes. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc3_rgba_unorm_srgb.doc: BC3 (DXT5) compressed RGBA with sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc4_r_unorm.doc: BC4 compressed single channel, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc4_r_snorm.doc: BC4 compressed single channel, signed normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc5_rg_unorm.doc: BC5 compressed two channels, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc5_rg_snorm.doc: BC5 compressed two channels, signed normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc6h_rgb_ufloat.doc: BC6H compressed HDR RGB, unsigned float. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc6h_rgb_float.doc: BC6H compressed HDR RGB, signed float. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc7_rgba_unorm.doc: BC7 compressed RGBA, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

bc7_rgba_unorm_srgb.doc: BC7 compressed RGBA with sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_bc.

etc2_rgb8unorm.doc: ETC2 compressed RGB, 8 bits per channel, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

etc2_rgb8unorm_srgb.doc: ETC2 compressed RGB with sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

etc2_rgb8a1unorm.doc: ETC2 compressed RGB with 1-bit punch-through alpha, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

etc2_rgb8a1unorm_srgb.doc: ETC2 compressed RGB with 1-bit alpha and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

etc2_rgba8unorm.doc: ETC2 compressed RGBA, 8 bits per channel, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

etc2_rgba8unorm_srgb.doc: ETC2 compressed RGBA with sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

eac_r11unorm.doc: EAC compressed single channel, 11-bit unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

eac_r11snorm.doc: EAC compressed single channel, 11-bit signed normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

eac_rg11unorm.doc: EAC compressed two channels, 11-bit unsigned normalized each. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

eac_rg11snorm.doc: EAC compressed two channels, 11-bit signed normalized each. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_etc2.

astc_4x4_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 4x4 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_4x4_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 4x4 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_5x4_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 5x4 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_5x4_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 5x4 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_5x5_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 5x5 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_5x5_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 5x5 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_6x5_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 6x5 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_6x5_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 6x5 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_6x6_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 6x6 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_6x6_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 6x6 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_8x5_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 8x5 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_8x5_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 8x5 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_8x6_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 8x6 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_8x6_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 8x6 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_8x8_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 8x8 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_8x8_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 8x8 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x5_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x5 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x5_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x5 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x6_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x6 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x6_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x6 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x8_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x8 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x8_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x8 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x10_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x10 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_10x10_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 10x10 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_12x10_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 12x10 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_12x10_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 12x10 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_12x12_unorm.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 12x12 blocks, unsigned normalized. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

astc_12x12_unorm_srgb.doc: ASTC compressed RGBA with 12x12 blocks and sRGB encoding. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_compression_astc.

TextureFormat.doc:
The pixel format of a GPUTexture.

Names are of the form: channels, bit size per channel, and a type suffix.
The suffixes mean: unorm = unsigned normalized (0..1), snorm = signed normalized (-1..1),
uint/sint = unsigned/signed integer, float = floating point, and srgb = the color
is stored in sRGB and automatically converted to linear when sampled (and back when written).
Some formats require a feature (see enums.FeatureName), and not all formats can be used with all usages (see flags.TextureUsage).

clamp_to_edge.doc: Coordinates are clamped to the range 0..1, so the edge texels are repeated.

repeat.doc: The texture tiles: only the fractional part of the coordinate is used.

mirror_repeat.doc: The texture tiles, but is mirrored every other repetition.

AddressMode.doc:
How a sampler handles texture coordinates outside the 0..1 range, per axis.

Used in the address_mode_u, address_mode_v and address_mode_w fields of structs.SamplerDescriptor.

nearest.doc: Use the value of the nearest texel.

linear.doc: Linearly interpolate between the nearest texels.

FilterMode.doc:
How a sampler filters texels when a texture is magnified or minified.

Used in the mag_filter and min_filter fields of structs.SamplerDescriptor.

linear.doc: Linearly interpolate between the two nearest mip levels.

MipmapFilterMode.doc:
How a sampler filters between mip levels.

Used in the mipmap_filter field of structs.SamplerDescriptor.

less.doc: Passes if the new value is less than the existing value.

equal.doc: Passes if the new value is equal to the existing value.

less_equal.doc: Passes if the new value is less than or equal to the existing value.

greater.doc: Passes if the new value is greater than the existing value.

not_equal.doc: Passes if the new value is not equal to the existing value.

greater_equal.doc: Passes if the new value is greater than or equal to the existing value.

CompareFunction.doc:
A comparison function, used for depth testing, stencil testing and comparison samplers.

The comparison is made as: new_value (the incoming fragment, or the sampled reference) compared to
the existing value. If the comparison is true, the test passes.

uniform.doc: A uniform buffer: read-only, limited in size, and fast. Requires flags.BufferUsage.UNIFORM.

storage.doc: A read-write storage buffer. Requires flags.BufferUsage.STORAGE.

read_only_storage.doc: A read-only storage buffer. Requires flags.BufferUsage.STORAGE.

BufferBindingType.doc:
The type of a buffer binding in a bind group layout.

Used in the type field of structs.BufferBindingLayout.

filtering.doc: A sampler that may filter (linear) texels. Can be used with textures of sample type float, but not unfilterable_float.

non_filtering.doc: A sampler that only uses nearest filtering. Can be used with any float texture.

comparison.doc: A comparison sampler, used for depth textures (see the compare field of structs.SamplerDescriptor).

SamplerBindingType.doc:
The type of a sampler binding in a bind group layout.

Used in the type field of structs.SamplerBindingLayout.

float.doc: Floating point values; the texture can be sampled with a filtering sampler.

unfilterable_float.doc: Floating point values, but the texture cannot be filtered (e.g. 32-bit float without enums.FeatureName.float32_filterable).

depth.doc: Depth values, as returned from depth textures. Can be sampled as float, or with a comparison sampler.

TextureSampleType.doc:
The type of values that is returned when sampling a texture in a shader.

Used in the sample_type field of structs.TextureBindingLayout.

write_only.doc: The shader can only write to the texture.

read_only.doc: The shader can only read from the texture.

read_write.doc: The shader can both read from and write to the texture.

StorageTextureAccess.doc:
How a storage texture can be accessed by a shader.

Used in the access field of structs.StorageTextureBindingLayout.

error.doc: An error; the shader module is invalid.

warning.doc: A warning; the shader module is valid but something may be wrong.

validation.doc: The pipeline failed validation, e.g. because of an invalid descriptor or shader.

internal.doc: An internal error occurred when creating the pipeline, e.g. the shader could not be compiled by the backend.

PipelineErrorReason.doc:
The reason for a GPUPipelineError.

Available via the reason property of GPUPipelineError.

auto.doc: Derive the pipeline layout from the shader.

AutoLayoutMode.doc:
Indicates that a pipeline layout should be derived automatically from the shader code.

Used as the layout field of structs.ComputePipelineDescriptor and structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor.
The resulting bind group layouts can be retrieved with GPUPipelineBase.get_bind_group_layout().

line_list.doc: Each pair of vertices defines a separate line.

line_strip.doc: Each vertex after the first defines a line to the previous vertex.

triangle_list.doc: Each triple of vertices defines a separate triangle.

triangle_strip.doc: Each vertex after the first two defines a triangle with the previous two vertices.

PrimitiveTopology.doc:
How vertices are assembled into primitives.

Used in the topology field of structs.PrimitiveState.

ccw.doc: Triangles with counter-clockwise vertices (in framebuffer space) are front-facing.

cw.doc: Triangles with clockwise vertices (in framebuffer space) are front-facing.

FrontFace.doc:
Defines which winding order of a triangle is considered front-facing.

Used in the front_face field of structs.PrimitiveState.

CullMode.doc:
Defines which faces of triangles are culled (not drawn).

Used in the cull_mode field of structs.PrimitiveState.

one_minus_src.doc: One minus the source color, per component.

one_minus_dst.doc: One minus the destination color, per component.

src_alpha_saturated.doc: The minimum of the source alpha and one minus the destination alpha (for color), and 1 for alpha.

one_minus_constant.doc: One minus the blend constant color.

src1.doc: The second source color output of the fragment shader. Requires enums.FeatureName.dual_source_blending.

one_minus_src1.doc: One minus the second source color. Requires enums.FeatureName.dual_source_blending.

src1_alpha.doc: The second source alpha. Requires enums.FeatureName.dual_source_blending.

one_minus_src1_alpha.doc: One minus the second source alpha. Requires enums.FeatureName.dual_source_blending.

BlendFactor.doc:
A factor that is multiplied with the source or destination color or alpha in blending.

Used in the src_factor and dst_factor fields of structs.BlendComponent. In the descriptions,
src is the output of the fragment shader and dst is the existing value in the render target.

min.doc: Result is the minimum of source and destination (blend factors are ignored).

max.doc: Result is the maximum of source and destination (blend factors are ignored).

BlendOperation.doc:
The operation used to combine the scaled source and destination values in blending.

Used in the operation field of structs.BlendComponent.

zero.doc: Set the stencil value to zero.

replace.doc: Replace the stencil value with the stencil reference value, see GPURenderPassEncoder.set_stencil_reference().

invert.doc: Bitwise invert the current stencil value.

increment_clamp.doc: Increment the stencil value, clamping to the maximum.

decrement_clamp.doc: Decrement the stencil value, clamping to zero.

increment_wrap.doc: Increment the stencil value, wrapping to zero on overflow.

decrement_wrap.doc: Decrement the stencil value, wrapping to the maximum on underflow.

StencilOperation.doc:
The operation performed on the stencil buffer value after a stencil or depth test.

Used in the fail_op, depth_fail_op and pass_op fields of structs.StencilFaceState.

IndexFormat.doc:
The data type of the indices in an index buffer.

Used in the index_format argument of the GPURenderCommandsMixin.set_index_buffer() method
and the strip_index_format field of structs.PrimitiveState.

unorm10_10_10_2.doc: A packed 32-bit value with three 10-bit and one 2-bit unsigned normalized components, presented as a vec4 of float.

unorm8x4_bgra.doc: Four 8-bit unsigned normalized values stored in BGRA order, presented to the shader in RGBA order.

VertexFormat.doc:
The format of a vertex attribute in a vertex buffer.

Used in the format field of structs.VertexAttribute. The name consists of the component type and
bit size, optionally followed by xN for the number of components. The shader sees the data as
float (for unorm, snorm and float formats), i32 (for sint) or u32 (for uint), with the same number of components.

vertex.doc: The buffer is advanced for each vertex.

instance.doc: The buffer is advanced for each instance.

VertexStepMode.doc:
How often a vertex buffer is advanced.

Used in the step_mode field of structs.VertexBufferLayout.

load.doc: Keep the existing contents of the attachment.

clear.doc: Clear the attachment to the clear value (e.g. the clear_value field of structs.RenderPassColorAttachment). Clearing is preferred over load when the old contents are not needed; it can be faster, especially on tiled GPUs.

LoadOp.doc:
What happens to the contents of an attachment at the start of a render pass.

Used in the load_op fields of structs.RenderPassColorAttachment and structs.RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment.

store.doc: Store the results of the render pass in the attachment.

discard.doc: Discard the results; the contents of the attachment become undefined (zero-initialized when next used).

StoreOp.doc:
What happens to the contents of an attachment at the end of a render pass.

Used in the store_op fields of structs.RenderPassColorAttachment and structs.RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment.

occlusion.doc: Occlusion queries count the number of samples that pass the depth and stencil tests, see GPURenderPassEncoder.begin_occlusion_query().

timestamp.doc: Timestamp queries record GPU timestamps. Requires enums.FeatureName.timestamp_query.

QueryType.doc:
The type of queries in a GPUQuerySet.

Used in the type field of structs.QuerySetDescriptor.

opaque.doc: The alpha channel is ignored and the canvas is treated as fully opaque.

premultiplied.doc: The color channels are expected to be premultiplied by the alpha channel.

CanvasAlphaMode.doc:
How the alpha channel of a canvas texture is interpreted when compositing with the page or window.

Used in the alpha_mode field of structs.CanvasConfiguration.

standard.doc: Color values are clamped to the standard dynamic range (SDR) of the display.

extended.doc: Color values may exceed the SDR range, up to the dynamic range of the display (HDR).

CanvasToneMappingMode.doc:
How the content of a canvas is tone mapped when displayed.

Used in the mode field of structs.CanvasToneMapping.

unknown.doc: The device was lost for a reason other than being destroyed, e.g. a driver crash or hardware removal.

destroyed.doc: The device was lost because GPUDevice.destroy() was called.

DeviceLostReason.doc:
The reason a GPUDevice was lost.

Available via the reason property of GPUDeviceLostInfo.

validation.doc: Captures GPUValidationError errors, which signal incorrect API usage.

out_of_memory.doc: Captures GPUOutOfMemoryError errors, which signal that there was not enough memory for an operation.

internal.doc: Captures GPUInternalError errors, which signal failures not caused by incorrect usage (e.g. implementation limits).

ErrorFilter.doc:
The type of error that is captured by an error scope.

Used in the filter argument of the GPUDevice.push_error_scope() method.

feature_level.doc: The feature level to request: 'core' (default) or 'compatibility'. Core implies the default limits and enums.FeatureName.core_features_and_limits; compatibility has stricter, more widely supported defaults and no features. If the implementation cannot enforce the compatibility rules it treats the request as core. If the level is not supported, no adapter is returned.

power_preference.doc: Hint for the kind of adapter to select, see enums.PowerPreference. It may influence which adapter is chosen (mainly in multi-GPU systems), but never whether an adapter is returned.

force_fallback_adapter.doc: If true, only a fallback adapter may be returned (no adapter if unsupported). If false, a fallback adapter may still be returned; check the is_fallback_adapter property of GPUAdapterInfo to avoid it.

xr_compatible.doc: If true, the adapter must be compatible with XR (virtual/augmented reality) sessions. Mostly relevant in browsers.

RequestAdapterOptions.doc:
Options for requesting an adapter.

Used as the options argument of the GPU.request_adapter() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the device, used in debugging and error messages.

required_features.doc: A list of enums.FeatureName that the device must support. The request fails if the adapter cannot provide them. Exactly this set of features, no more and no less, is allowed on the resulting device.

required_limits.doc: A mapping of limit names to the values the device requires; the request fails if the adapter cannot provide them. Unspecified limits get their default value. Validation on the device uses these exact limits, not the (possibly higher) limits of the adapter.

default_queue.doc: A structs.QueueDescriptor with options for the default queue of the device.

DeviceDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for requesting a device.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUAdapter.request_device() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the buffer, used in debugging and error messages.

size.doc: The size of the buffer in bytes.

usage.doc: The allowed usages of the buffer, a combination of flags.BufferUsage.

mapped_at_creation.doc: If true, the buffer is created in a mapped state so GPUBuffer.get_mapped_range() can be called immediately, which is useful to set initial data. This is allowed even without flags.BufferUsage.MAP_READ or flags.BufferUsage.MAP_WRITE. The size must then be a multiple of 4.

BufferDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUBuffer.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_buffer() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the texture, used in debugging and error messages.

size.doc: The size of the texture as a structs.Extent3D, or a tuple of (width, height, depth_or_array_layers). Height and depth default to 1.

mip_level_count.doc: The number of mip levels. Defaults to 1.

sample_count.doc: The number of samples per pixel, for multisampled textures. Must be 1 or 4. Defaults to 1.

dimension.doc: The dimensionality of the texture, see enums.TextureDimension. Defaults to d2.

format.doc: The pixel format of the texture, see enums.TextureFormat.

usage.doc: The allowed usages of the texture, a combination of flags.TextureUsage.

view_formats.doc: Additional enums.TextureFormat values that views of this texture may use in GPUTexture.create_view(). They must be view-compatible with the texture format: equal, or (on devices with enums.FeatureName.core_features_and_limits) differing only in sRGB-ness. Adding formats can hurt performance on some systems, so only add what is needed.

texture_binding_view_dimension.doc: Compatibility mode only: on devices without enums.FeatureName.core_features_and_limits, views of this texture must have this enums.TextureViewDimension. A default is chosen if omitted. Ignored on core devices.

TextureDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUTexture.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_texture() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the texture view, used in debugging and error messages.

format.doc: The format of the view, see enums.TextureFormat. Must be the texture format or one of its view_formats. Defaults to the texture format.

dimension.doc: The dimensionality of the view, see enums.TextureViewDimension. Defaults to a dimension matching the texture.

usage.doc: The usages the view will be used for, a subset of the usage of the texture (see flags.TextureUsage). If 0 or omitted, defaults to all usages of the texture; this fails if the view format does not support all of them, in which case set it explicitly.

aspect.doc: Which aspect of the texture the view refers to, see enums.TextureAspect. Defaults to all.

base_mip_level.doc: The first mip level accessible via the view. Defaults to 0.

mip_level_count.doc: The number of mip levels accessible via the view. Defaults to all levels from base_mip_level.

base_array_layer.doc: The first array layer accessible via the view. Defaults to 0.

array_layer_count.doc: The number of array layers accessible via the view. Defaults to all layers from base_array_layer.

swizzle.doc: A string of four characters (default 'rgba') that defines how the components of the view are mapped, e.g. 'bgra'. Allowed characters are r, g, b, a, 0 and 1. Requires enums.FeatureName.texture_component_swizzle.

TextureViewDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUTextureView.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUTexture.create_view() method. Unspecified fields
get a default derived from the texture, so by default the view covers the whole texture.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the external texture, used in debugging and error messages.

source.doc: The source of the image data, e.g. a video element or video frame. Only meaningful in browser environments.

color_space.doc: The color space of the source image, e.g. 'srgb'. Defaults to 'srgb'.

ExternalTextureDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for importing an external texture, such as a video frame.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.import_external_texture() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the sampler, used in debugging and error messages.

address_mode_u.doc: How to handle texture coordinates outside 0..1 along the u (x) axis, see enums.AddressMode. Defaults to clamp_to_edge.

address_mode_v.doc: How to handle texture coordinates outside 0..1 along the v (y) axis, see enums.AddressMode. Defaults to clamp_to_edge.

address_mode_w.doc: How to handle texture coordinates outside 0..1 along the w (z) axis, see enums.AddressMode. Defaults to clamp_to_edge.

mag_filter.doc: The filter used when the sampled area is smaller than or equal to one texel (magnification), see enums.FilterMode. Defaults to nearest.

min_filter.doc: The filter used when the sampled area is larger than one texel (minification), see enums.FilterMode. Defaults to nearest.

mipmap_filter.doc: How to filter between mip levels, see enums.MipmapFilterMode. Defaults to nearest.

lod_min_clamp.doc: The minimum level of detail used when sampling. Defaults to 0.

lod_max_clamp.doc: The maximum level of detail used when sampling. Defaults to 32.

compare.doc: If set, makes this a comparison sampler using this enums.CompareFunction. Used for sampling depth textures. Filtering results of comparison samplers are implementation-dependent.

max_anisotropy.doc: The maximum anisotropy for anisotropic filtering: 1 (default) disables it. Values above 1 require all filters to be linear. The value is clamped to the platform maximum (typically 16).

SamplerDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUSampler.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_sampler() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the bind group layout, used in debugging and error messages.

entries.doc: A list of structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry describing the resources in the bind group.

BindGroupLayoutDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUBindGroupLayout.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_bind_group_layout() method.

binding.doc: The binding number, matching the @binding attribute in the shader.

visibility.doc: The shader stages in which the resource is visible, a combination of flags.ShaderStage.

buffer.doc: If set, a structs.BufferBindingLayout: the entry is a buffer binding.

sampler.doc: If set, a structs.SamplerBindingLayout: the entry is a sampler binding.

texture.doc: If set, a structs.TextureBindingLayout: the entry is a sampled texture binding.

storage_texture.doc: If set, a structs.StorageTextureBindingLayout: the entry is a storage texture binding.

BindGroupLayoutEntry.doc:
Describes a single binding in a bind group layout.

Exactly one of buffer, sampler, texture, storage_texture and external_texture must be set,
which determines the type of resource that is bound.

type.doc: The type of buffer binding, see enums.BufferBindingType. Defaults to uniform.

has_dynamic_offset.doc: If true, an offset can be given in GPUBindingCommandsMixin.set_bind_group() when binding. Defaults to false.

min_binding_size.doc: The minimum size in bytes of a buffer bound to this entry; bindings are always validated against it in GPUDevice.create_bind_group(). If non-zero, pipeline creation also checks it against the minimum binding size of the shader variable. If 0 (default), that check is skipped at pipeline creation and done at draw/dispatch time instead.

BufferBindingLayout.doc:
Describes the layout of a buffer binding.

Used in the buffer field of structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry.

type.doc: The type of sampler binding, see enums.SamplerBindingType. Defaults to filtering.

SamplerBindingLayout.doc:
Describes the layout of a sampler binding.

Used in the sampler field of structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry.

sample_type.doc: The type of values returned when sampling, see enums.TextureSampleType. Defaults to float.

view_dimension.doc: The dimension of texture views that can be bound, see enums.TextureViewDimension. Defaults to d2.

multisampled.doc: If true, the bound texture must be multisampled. Defaults to false.

TextureBindingLayout.doc:
Describes the layout of a sampled texture binding.

Used in the texture field of structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry.

access.doc: How the shader can access the texture, see enums.StorageTextureAccess. Defaults to write_only.

format.doc: The enums.TextureFormat that the bound texture view must have.

view_dimension.doc: The dimension of texture views that can be bound, see enums.TextureViewDimension. Defaults to d2.

StorageTextureBindingLayout.doc:
Describes the layout of a storage texture binding.

Used in the storage_texture field of structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the bind group, used in debugging and error messages.

layout.doc: The GPUBindGroupLayout that this bind group conforms to.

entries.doc: A list of structs.BindGroupEntry with the resources to bind. Must match the layout.

BindGroupDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUBindGroup.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_bind_group() method.

binding.doc: The binding number, matching the binding field of the corresponding structs.BindGroupLayoutEntry.

resource.type: GPUBuffer | GPUSampler | GPUTexture | GPUTextureView | object | structs.BufferBindingStruct
resource.doc: The resource to bind: a GPUSampler, GPUTexture (as its default view), GPUTextureView, GPUBuffer (the whole buffer), structs.BufferBinding, or GPUExternalTexture. Must match the type in the corresponding layout entry.

BindGroupEntry.doc:
A single resource binding in a bind group.

Used in the entries field of structs.BindGroupDescriptor.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes into the buffer where the binding starts. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The size in bytes of the binding. Defaults to the remainder of the buffer after offset.

BufferBinding.doc:
Describes a range of a GPUBuffer to bind.

Can be used as the resource field of structs.BindGroupEntry.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the pipeline layout, used in debugging and error messages.

bind_group_layouts.doc: A list of GPUBindGroupLayout (or None for unused groups) used by the pipeline. The Nth element corresponds to @group(N) in the shader.

immediate_size.doc: The size in bytes of the immediate data (small data set with GPUBindingCommandsMixin.set_immediates()). Defaults to 0.

PipelineLayoutDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUPipelineLayout.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_pipeline_layout() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the shader module, used in debugging and error messages.

code.doc: The shader source code, in WGSL.

compilation_hints.doc: An optional list of structs.ShaderModuleCompilationHint that may help the implementation compile early. Hints only affect performance, are not validated, and only apply to the entry points they name (there is no default entry point).

ShaderModuleDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUShaderModule.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_shader_module() method.

entry_point.doc: The name of the shader entry point that the hint applies to.

layout.doc: The GPUPipelineLayout that the entry point will be used with, or enums.AutoLayoutMode.auto (the default pipeline layout for that entry point).

ShaderModuleCompilationHint.doc:
A hint for the compilation of a shader module.

Used in the compilation_hints field of structs.ShaderModuleDescriptor. These are optional and only
affect performance, not behavior.

reason.doc: The reason for the error, see enums.PipelineErrorReason.

PipelineErrorInit.doc:
Initialization options for a GPUPipelineError.

Used as the options argument of the GPUPipelineError constructor.

module.doc: The GPUShaderModule containing the shader code.

entry_point.doc: The name of the entry point function in the shader. Optional if the module has only one entry point for this stage.

constants.doc: A mapping of the identifiers of pipeline-overridable constants in the shader to the values to use. A key is the numeric id (if the shader declares one) or the name of the constant. Values are converted to the WGSL type of the constant; a failed conversion is a validation error.

ProgrammableStage.doc:
Describes a programmable (shader) stage of a pipeline.

This is the base for structs.VertexState, structs.FragmentState and the compute field of
structs.ComputePipelineDescriptor.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the pipeline, used in debugging and error messages.

layout.doc: The GPUPipelineLayout for the pipeline, or enums.AutoLayoutMode.auto to derive it from the shader(s). With auto, the pipeline cannot share bind groups with other pipelines.

compute.doc: A structs.ProgrammableStage describing the compute shader.

ComputePipelineDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUComputePipeline.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_compute_pipeline() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the pipeline, used in debugging and error messages.

layout.doc: The GPUPipelineLayout for the pipeline, or enums.AutoLayoutMode.auto to derive it from the shader(s). With auto, the pipeline cannot share bind groups with other pipelines.

vertex.doc: A structs.VertexState describing the vertex shader and vertex buffers.

primitive.doc: A structs.PrimitiveState describing how primitives are assembled and rasterized.

depth_stencil.doc: An optional structs.DepthStencilState. If omitted, the pipeline does not use a depth-stencil attachment.

fragment.doc: An optional structs.FragmentState describing the fragment shader and render targets. If omitted, the pipeline has no color output (e.g. for depth-only passes).

RenderPipelineDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPURenderPipeline.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_render_pipeline() method.

topology.doc: How vertices are assembled into primitives, see enums.PrimitiveTopology. Defaults to triangle_list.

strip_index_format.doc: The enums.IndexFormat of the index buffer, which sets the primitive restart value (0xFFFF for uint16, 0xFFFFFFFF for uint32). Only allowed for strip topologies, where it is required for indexed draws and must match the format given to GPURenderCommandsMixin.set_index_buffer().

front_face.doc: Which winding order is front-facing, see enums.FrontFace. Defaults to ccw.

cull_mode.doc: Which faces to cull, see enums.CullMode. Defaults to none.

unclipped_depth.doc: If true, primitives are not clipped by the near and far planes. Requires enums.FeatureName.depth_clip_control.

PrimitiveState.doc:
Describes how a render pipeline assembles and rasterizes primitives.

Used in the primitive field of structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor.

count.doc: The number of samples per pixel. Must be 1 or 4. The pipeline is only compatible with attachments that have a matching sample count. Defaults to 1.

mask.doc: A bitmask that determines which samples are written to. Defaults to 0xFFFFFFFF.

alpha_to_coverage_enabled.doc: If true, the alpha output of the fragment shader is used to generate a coverage mask. Defaults to false.

MultisampleState.doc:
Describes the multisampling of a render pipeline.

Used in the multisample field of structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor.

module.doc: The GPUShaderModule containing the fragment shader code.

entry_point.doc: The name of the fragment entry point in the shader. Optional if the module has only one fragment entry point.

constants.doc: A mapping of the identifiers of pipeline-overridable constants in the shader to the values to use. A key is the numeric id (if the shader declares one) or the name of the constant. Values are converted to the WGSL type of the constant; a failed conversion is a validation error.

targets.doc: A list of structs.ColorTargetState (or None for unused slots), one for each color attachment.

FragmentState.doc:
Describes the fragment shader stage and render targets of a render pipeline.

Used in the fragment field of structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor. Extends structs.ProgrammableStage.

format.doc: The enums.TextureFormat of this color target. The pipeline is only compatible with render passes that use a view of this format in the corresponding color attachment.

blend.doc: An optional structs.BlendState. If omitted, blending is disabled and the fragment output replaces the target.

write_mask.doc: Which channels are written, a combination of flags.ColorWrite. Defaults to ALL.

ColorTargetState.doc:
Describes a color render target of a render pipeline.

Used in the targets field of structs.FragmentState.

color.doc: A structs.BlendComponent for the color (RGB) channels.

alpha.doc: A structs.BlendComponent for the alpha channel.

BlendState.doc:
Describes how blending is performed for a color target.

Used in the blend field of structs.ColorTargetState.

operation.doc: The enums.BlendOperation used to combine the scaled values. Defaults to add.

src_factor.doc: The enums.BlendFactor applied to the source (fragment shader output). Defaults to one.

dst_factor.doc: The enums.BlendFactor applied to the destination (existing target value). Defaults to zero.

BlendComponent.doc:
Describes how the blending of a single component (color or alpha) is performed.

The result is: operation(src * src_factor, dst * dst_factor).

format.doc: The enums.TextureFormat of the depth-stencil attachment that this pipeline is compatible with.

depth_write_enabled.doc: If true, depth values of fragments that pass the depth test are written to the attachment.

depth_compare.doc: The enums.CompareFunction used for the depth test.

stencil_read_mask.doc: Bitmask applied to the stencil values before comparison. Defaults to 0xFFFFFFFF.

stencil_write_mask.doc: Bitmask that determines which bits of the stencil buffer are written. Defaults to 0xFFFFFFFF.

depth_bias.doc: A constant depth value added to each fragment. Defaults to 0.

depth_bias_slope_scale.doc: A depth bias that scales with the slope of the primitive. Defaults to 0.

depth_bias_clamp.doc: The maximum (or minimum, if negative) depth bias of a fragment. Defaults to 0.

DepthStencilState.doc:
Describes the depth and stencil state of a render pipeline.

Used in the depth_stencil field of structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor.

compare.doc: The enums.CompareFunction used to compare the stencil reference with the stencil value. Defaults to always.

fail_op.doc: The enums.StencilOperation performed if the stencil test fails. Defaults to keep.

depth_fail_op.doc: The enums.StencilOperation performed if the stencil test passes but the depth test fails. Defaults to keep.

pass_op.doc: The enums.StencilOperation performed if both the stencil and depth tests pass. Defaults to keep.

StencilFaceState.doc:
Describes the stencil operations for one face (front or back) of primitives.

Used in the stencil_front and stencil_back fields of structs.DepthStencilState.

module.doc: The GPUShaderModule containing the vertex shader code.

entry_point.doc: The name of the vertex entry point in the shader. Optional if the module has only one vertex entry point.

constants.doc: A mapping of the identifiers of pipeline-overridable constants in the shader to the values to use. A key is the numeric id (if the shader declares one) or the name of the constant. Values are converted to the WGSL type of the constant; a failed conversion is a validation error.

buffers.doc: A list of structs.VertexBufferLayout (or None for unused slots) describing the vertex buffers.

VertexState.doc:
Describes the vertex shader stage and vertex buffers of a render pipeline.

Used in the vertex field of structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor. Extends structs.ProgrammableStage.

array_stride.doc: The stride in bytes between consecutive elements in the buffer.

step_mode.doc: How often the buffer is advanced, see enums.VertexStepMode. Defaults to vertex.

attributes.doc: A list of structs.VertexAttribute describing the attributes in each element.

VertexBufferLayout.doc:
Describes the layout of a vertex buffer.

Used in the buffers field of structs.VertexState.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes of the attribute from the start of an element in the buffer.

shader_location.doc: The location number of the attribute in the vertex shader (the @location attribute).

VertexAttribute.doc:
Describes a single vertex attribute within a vertex buffer.

Used in the attributes field of structs.VertexBufferLayout.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes into the data where the texel data starts. Defaults to 0.

bytes_per_row.doc: The stride in bytes between the start of consecutive rows of texel blocks. Required if the copy has more than one row of texel blocks. Must be a multiple of 256 for buffer copies (not for GPUQueue.write_texture()).

rows_per_image.doc: The number of rows of texel blocks per image (layer or slice); times bytes_per_row it is the stride between images. Required if the copy has more than one image.

TexelCopyBufferLayout.doc:
Describes the layout of texel data in a buffer or in a block of memory.

Used as the data_layout argument of the GPUQueue.write_texture() method. Also see structs.TexelCopyBufferInfo.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes into the buffer where the texel data starts. Defaults to 0.

bytes_per_row.doc: The stride in bytes between the start of consecutive rows of texel blocks. Required if the copy has more than one row. Must be a multiple of 256.

rows_per_image.doc: The number of rows of texel blocks per image (layer or slice). Required if the copy has more than one image.

buffer.doc: The GPUBuffer that contains (or will contain) the texel data.

TexelCopyBufferInfo.doc:
Describes a buffer and the layout of texel data in it.

Used as source or destination in GPUCommandEncoder.copy_buffer_to_texture() and GPUCommandEncoder.copy_texture_to_buffer().
Extends structs.TexelCopyBufferLayout.

texture.doc: The GPUTexture to copy to or from.

mip_level.doc: The mip level to copy to or from. Defaults to 0.

origin.doc: The origin of the copy in the texture, as a structs.Origin3D or a tuple (x, y, z). Defaults to (0, 0, 0).

aspect.doc: Which aspect of the texture to copy, see enums.TextureAspect. Defaults to all.

TexelCopyTextureInfo.doc:
Describes a texture and the part of it that is the source or destination of a copy.

Used in GPUCommandEncoder.copy_buffer_to_texture(), GPUCommandEncoder.copy_texture_to_buffer(),
GPUCommandEncoder.copy_texture_to_texture() and GPUQueue.write_texture().

label.doc: A human-readable label for the command buffer, used in debugging and error messages.

CommandBufferDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for a GPUCommandBuffer.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUCommandEncoder.finish() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the command encoder, used in debugging and error messages.

CommandEncoderDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUCommandEncoder.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_command_encoder() method.

query_set.doc: The GPUQuerySet (of type enums.QueryType.timestamp) to write the timestamps to.

beginning_of_pass_write_index.doc: The index in the query set where the timestamp at the start of the pass is written. If omitted, no timestamp is written.

end_of_pass_write_index.doc: The index in the query set where the timestamp at the end of the pass is written. If omitted, no timestamp is written.

ComputePassTimestampWrites.doc:
Describes where to write timestamps for a compute pass.

Used in the timestamp_writes field of structs.ComputePassDescriptor. Requires enums.FeatureName.timestamp_query.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the compute pass, used in debugging and error messages.

timestamp_writes.doc: An optional structs.ComputePassTimestampWrites for recording timestamps of the pass.

ComputePassDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for beginning a compute pass.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUCommandEncoder.begin_compute_pass() method.

query_set.doc: The GPUQuerySet (of type enums.QueryType.timestamp) to write the timestamps to.

beginning_of_pass_write_index.doc: The index in the query set where the timestamp at the start of the pass is written. If omitted, no timestamp is written.

end_of_pass_write_index.doc: The index in the query set where the timestamp at the end of the pass is written. If omitted, no timestamp is written.

RenderPassTimestampWrites.doc:
Describes where to write timestamps for a render pass.

Used in the timestamp_writes field of structs.RenderPassDescriptor. Requires enums.FeatureName.timestamp_query.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the render pass, used in debugging and error messages.

color_attachments.doc: A list of structs.RenderPassColorAttachment (or None for unused slots) that the pass renders to. Attachments may not alias each other or any resource used inside the pass.

depth_stencil_attachment.doc: An optional structs.RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment for depth and stencil.

occlusion_query_set.doc: An optional GPUQuerySet of type enums.QueryType.occlusion, to store occlusion query results in.

timestamp_writes.doc: An optional structs.RenderPassTimestampWrites for recording timestamps of the pass.

max_draw_count.doc: A hint for the maximum number of draw calls in the pass, used by some implementations to size internal work. The default is fine unless more draws are expected. Defaults to 50000000.

RenderPassDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for beginning a render pass.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUCommandEncoder.begin_render_pass() method.

view.doc: The GPUTextureView to render to. Its texture must have flags.TextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT.

depth_slice.doc: For 3D textures, the index of the depth slice to render to.

resolve_target.doc: An optional GPUTextureView to resolve the (multisampled) view into at the end of the pass.

clear_value.doc: The color to clear the attachment to if load_op is clear, as a structs.Color or a tuple (r, g, b, a). Defaults to transparent black.

load_op.doc: What to do with the existing contents at the start of the pass, see enums.LoadOp.

store_op.doc: What to do with the results at the end of the pass, see enums.StoreOp.

RenderPassColorAttachment.doc:
Describes a color attachment of a render pass.

Used in the color_attachments field of structs.RenderPassDescriptor.

view.doc: The GPUTextureView to use as depth-stencil attachment. Its texture must have flags.TextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT.

depth_clear_value.doc: The value to clear the depth aspect to if depth_load_op is clear. Must be between 0 and 1.

depth_load_op.doc: What to do with the existing depth values at the start of the pass, see enums.LoadOp. Required unless depth_read_only is true.

depth_store_op.doc: What to do with the depth values at the end of the pass, see enums.StoreOp. Required unless depth_read_only is true.

depth_read_only.doc: If true, the depth aspect is read-only in the pass (it is not written to). Defaults to false.

stencil_clear_value.doc: The value to clear the stencil aspect to if stencil_load_op is clear. Truncated to the bit size of the stencil aspect (the least significant bits are kept). Defaults to 0.

stencil_load_op.doc: What to do with the existing stencil values at the start of the pass, see enums.LoadOp. Required unless stencil_read_only is true.

stencil_store_op.doc: What to do with the stencil values at the end of the pass, see enums.StoreOp. Required unless stencil_read_only is true.

stencil_read_only.doc: If true, the stencil aspect is read-only in the pass (it is not written to). Defaults to false.

RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment.doc:
Describes the depth-stencil attachment of a render pass.

Used in the depth_stencil_attachment field of structs.RenderPassDescriptor.

label.doc: A human-readable label, used in debugging and error messages.

color_formats.doc: A list of enums.TextureFormat (or None for unused slots) of the color attachments.

depth_stencil_format.doc: The enums.TextureFormat of the depth-stencil attachment, if any.

sample_count.doc: The number of samples per pixel of the attachments. Defaults to 1.

RenderPassLayout.doc:
Describes the attachment formats of a render pass or render bundle.

This is the base of structs.RenderBundleEncoderDescriptor. A render pipeline can only be used with
passes (or bundles) whose layout is compatible with the pipeline.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the render bundle, used in debugging and error messages.

RenderBundleDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for a GPURenderBundle.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPURenderBundleEncoder.finish() method.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the render bundle encoder, used in debugging and error messages.

color_formats.doc: A list of enums.TextureFormat (or None for unused slots) of the color attachments the bundle will be used with.

depth_stencil_format.doc: The enums.TextureFormat of the depth-stencil attachment the bundle will be used with, if any.

sample_count.doc: The number of samples per pixel of the attachments the bundle will be used with. Defaults to 1.

depth_read_only.doc: If true, the bundle does not write to the depth aspect. Defaults to false.

stencil_read_only.doc: If true, the bundle does not write to the stencil aspect. Defaults to false.

RenderBundleEncoderDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPURenderBundleEncoder.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_render_bundle_encoder() method.
Extends structs.RenderPassLayout.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the queue, used in debugging and error messages.

QueueDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for a GPUQueue.

Used in the default_queue field of structs.DeviceDescriptor.

label.doc: A human-readable label for the query set, used in debugging and error messages.

type.doc: The type of queries in the set, see enums.QueryType.

count.doc: The number of queries in the set.

QuerySetDescriptor.doc:
Descriptor for creating a GPUQuerySet.

Used as the descriptor argument of the GPUDevice.create_query_set() method.

mode.doc: The tone mapping mode, see enums.CanvasToneMappingMode. Defaults to standard.

CanvasToneMapping.doc:
Describes the tone mapping of a canvas.

Used in the tone_mapping field of structs.CanvasConfiguration.

device.doc: The GPUDevice that the canvas textures will be used with.

format.doc: The enums.TextureFormat of the canvas textures; must be one of the supported canvas formats. Use GPU.get_preferred_canvas_format() for the best choice.

usage.doc: The usages of the canvas textures, a combination of flags.TextureUsage. Defaults to RENDER_ATTACHMENT, but that is not added automatically when usage is set explicitly, so include it to render to the canvas texture.

view_formats.doc: Additional enums.TextureFormat values that views of the canvas texture may use.

color_space.doc: The color space of the canvas, e.g. 'srgb' or 'display-p3'. Defaults to 'srgb'.

tone_mapping.doc: A structs.CanvasToneMapping that describes how the canvas content is tone mapped. May not be supported everywhere; detect support with GPUCanvasContext.get_configuration().

alpha_mode.doc: How the alpha channel of the canvas is interpreted, see enums.CanvasAlphaMode. Defaults to opaque.

CanvasConfiguration.doc:
Configuration for a GPUCanvasContext.

Used as the configuration argument of the GPUCanvasContext.configure() method.

error.doc: The GPUError (GPUValidationError, GPUOutOfMemoryError or GPUInternalError) that was not captured by an error scope.

UncapturedErrorEventInit.doc:
Initialization data for an uncaptured error event.

The event is passed to the callback set via the onuncapturederror property of GPUDevice.

Color.doc:
An RGBA color with floating point components.

Can also be given as a tuple (r, g, b, a). Used e.g. in the clear_value field of structs.RenderPassColorAttachment.

Origin2D.doc:
A 2D origin (offset) in a texture or image, in texels.

Can also be given as a tuple (x, y).

z.doc: The z coordinate (depth, or array layer). Defaults to 0.

Origin3D.doc:
A 3D origin (offset) in a texture, in texels.

Can also be given as a tuple (x, y, z).

height.doc: The height of the extent. Defaults to 1.

depth_or_array_layers.doc: The depth (for 3D textures) or the number of array layers (for other textures). Defaults to 1.

Extent3D.doc:
A 3D size (extent) of a texture, in texels.

Can also be given as a tuple (width, height, depth_or_array_layers).

label.doc: A human-readable label for the object, used in debugging and error messages. Initially taken from the label field of the descriptor used to create it.

GPUObjectBase.doc:
The base class of all GPU objects.

It provides the label property that is shared by all objects in the API.

vendor.doc: The name of the vendor of the adapter, e.g. 'nvidia' or 'amd'.

architecture.doc: The name of the family or class of GPUs the adapter belongs to.

device.doc: A vendor-specific identifier for the type of adapter (e.g. a PCI device id), if available. It does not uniquely identify a piece of hardware like a serial number.

description.doc: A human-readable description of the adapter as reported by the driver, e.g. the name of the GPU. Not formatted in any standard way, so parsing it is not recommended; prefer the other fields.

subgroup_min_size.doc: The minimum supported subgroup size of the adapter. Only available if enums.FeatureName.subgroups is supported.

subgroup_max_size.doc: The maximum supported subgroup size of the adapter. Only available if enums.FeatureName.subgroups is supported.

is_fallback_adapter.doc: Whether this is a fallback adapter, e.g. a software renderer.

GPUAdapterInfo.doc:
Information about a physical adapter (GPU).

An instance is available via the info property of GPUAdapter and the adapter_info property of GPUDevice.
The values are strings that are possibly empty if the information is not available.

wgsl_language_features.doc: The set of WGSL language features that are supported by the implementation.

returns.doc: A GPUAdapter, or None if no suitable adapter was found.

options.doc: A structs.RequestAdapterOptions with options for selecting the adapter.

request_adapter.doc:
Request a GPUAdapter, which represents a physical GPU (or a software equivalent).

The adapter can be used to inspect the capabilities (features and limits) of the GPU,
and to request a GPUDevice. If no suitable adapter is available, None is returned.

returns.doc: An enums.TextureFormat, either rgba8unorm or bgra8unorm.

get_preferred_canvas_format.doc:
Get the preferred texture format for presenting to a canvas.

Using this format for the format field of structs.CanvasConfiguration avoids a conversion when presenting.

GPU.doc:
The entry point of the API.

It is used to request a GPUAdapter. In wgpu-py an instance is available as wgpu.gpu.

features.doc: The set of enums.FeatureName that the adapter supports.

limits.doc: A mapping of limit names to the maximum values supported by the adapter.

info.doc: A GPUAdapterInfo with information about the adapter. The values are constant over time.

descriptor.doc: A structs.DeviceDescriptor with the required features and limits.

request_device.doc:
Request a GPUDevice from the adapter.

The device is the main object used to create resources and to submit work. An adapter can
only provide a single device; if it was already used, or if the requested features or limits
are not supported, the request fails.

GPUAdapter.doc:
Represents a physical GPU (or a software implementation of one).

An adapter can be used to inspect the capabilities of the GPU, and to request a GPUDevice,
which is used to do actual work. Adapters are obtained via GPU.request_adapter().

features.doc: The set of enums.FeatureName that are enabled on the device (exactly those it was created with).

limits.doc: A mapping of limit names to the values that are in effect for the device (exactly those it was created with).

adapter_info.doc: A GPUAdapterInfo with information about the adapter that this device was created from. The values are constant over time.

queue.doc: The default GPUQueue of the device.

lost.doc: A promise or future that stays pending for the lifetime of the device and resolves to a GPUDeviceLostInfo when the device is lost.

onuncapturederror.doc: A callback that is called with an event (see structs.UncapturedErrorEventInit) when an error occurs that is not captured by an error scope.

destroy.doc:
Destroy the device, preventing further operations on it.

Outstanding asynchronous operations fail. The device is lost with the reason enums.DeviceLostReason.destroyed, and all resources
created by the device become unusable. Destroying a device multiple times is allowed.

descriptor.doc: A structs.BufferDescriptor describing the buffer.

create_buffer.doc:
Create a GPUBuffer, a block of memory that can be used by the GPU.

Data can be written to the buffer using GPUQueue.write_buffer(), copy commands, or by mapping it (see GPUBuffer.map_async()).

descriptor.doc: A structs.TextureDescriptor describing the texture.

create_texture.doc:
Create a GPUTexture, an image resource (1D, 2D or 3D) that can be sampled or rendered to.

Textures are not accessed directly by shaders; use GPUTexture.create_view() to obtain a GPUTextureView.

descriptor.doc: A structs.SamplerDescriptor describing the sampler. If omitted, the defaults are used.

create_sampler.doc: Create a GPUSampler, which defines how a texture is sampled (filtering and addressing) in a shader.

descriptor.doc: A structs.BindGroupLayoutDescriptor describing the entries of the layout.

create_bind_group_layout.doc:
Create a GPUBindGroupLayout, which describes the types and visibility of the resources in a bind group.

A bind group layout is used in create_bind_group() and create_pipeline_layout().

descriptor.doc: A structs.PipelineLayoutDescriptor describing the bind group layouts.

create_pipeline_layout.doc: Create a GPUPipelineLayout, which describes all bind groups (and immediate data) used by a pipeline.

descriptor.doc: A structs.BindGroupDescriptor with the layout and the resources to bind.

create_bind_group.doc:
Create a GPUBindGroup, which binds actual resources (buffers, textures, samplers) to the slots described by a layout.

Bind groups are set on a pass encoder with GPUBindingCommandsMixin.set_bind_group().

descriptor.doc: A structs.ShaderModuleDescriptor containing the shader code.

create_shader_module.doc:
Create a GPUShaderModule from shader source code (WGSL).

Compilation errors do not raise immediately; use GPUShaderModule.get_compilation_info() to inspect messages,
or use error scopes (see push_error_scope()).

descriptor.doc: A structs.ComputePipelineDescriptor describing the pipeline.

create_compute_pipeline.doc:
Create a GPUComputePipeline, which describes a compute shader and its resources.

The pipeline is created immediately, which may block while the shader is compiled. Prefer create_compute_pipeline_async() when possible.

descriptor.doc: A structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor describing the pipeline.

create_render_pipeline.doc:
Create a GPURenderPipeline, which describes the full state of the graphics pipeline: shaders, vertex layout, rasterization, depth/stencil, blending and render targets.

The pipeline is created immediately, which may block while the shaders are compiled. Prefer create_render_pipeline_async() when possible.

descriptor.doc: A structs.ComputePipelineDescriptor describing the pipeline.

create_compute_pipeline_async.doc:
Asynchronous version of create_compute_pipeline().

The result is ready to be used without additional delay once the promise (or future) resolves. If creation fails, a GPUPipelineError is raised instead of an error being generated on the device.
Using this method is preferred whenever possible, as it avoids blocking queue work on pipeline compilation.

descriptor.doc: A structs.RenderPipelineDescriptor describing the pipeline.

create_render_pipeline_async.doc:
Asynchronous version of create_render_pipeline().

The result is ready to be used without additional delay once the promise (or future) resolves. If creation fails, a GPUPipelineError is raised instead of an error being generated on the device.
Using this method is preferred whenever possible, as it avoids blocking queue work on pipeline compilation.

descriptor.doc: A structs.CommandEncoderDescriptor. Optional.

create_command_encoder.doc:
Create a GPUCommandEncoder, used to record GPU commands (passes and copies).

Finish the encoder with GPUCommandEncoder.finish() and submit the result with GPUQueue.submit().

descriptor.doc: A structs.RenderBundleEncoderDescriptor describing the attachment formats.

create_render_bundle_encoder.doc:
Create a GPURenderBundleEncoder, used to pre-record a sequence of render commands that can be replayed in many render passes.

The attachment formats given in the descriptor determine in which render passes the resulting bundle can be used.

descriptor.doc: A structs.QuerySetDescriptor describing the type and count of queries.

create_query_set.doc:
Create a GPUQuerySet, a set of queries that hold e.g. occlusion or timestamp results.

Results are written during passes and can be retrieved with GPUCommandEncoder.resolve_query_set().

filter.doc: The type of error to capture, see enums.ErrorFilter.

push_error_scope.doc:
Push a new error scope onto the device's error scope stack.

While the scope is active, errors of the given type that are generated by operations on this device are
captured by the scope (instead of triggering the onuncapturederror callback). Retrieve them with pop_error_scope().

returns.doc: A GPUError (GPUValidationError, GPUOutOfMemoryError or GPUInternalError), or None if no error was captured.

pop_error_scope.doc:
Pop the most recent error scope from the stack and return an error observed by it.

Fails if there is no error scope to pop. Errors are only reported once all operations in the scope have been processed.

GPUDevice.doc:
The main object that is used to create GPU resources and to submit work.

A device is requested from a GPUAdapter. It is a GPUObjectBase, and has a GPUQueue
(the queue property) which is used to submit work to the GPU. Most resources
(buffers, textures, pipelines, etc.) are created using the create_* methods of the device.

size.doc: The size of the buffer in bytes.

usage.doc: The usage of the buffer, a combination of flags.BufferUsage.

map_state.doc: The current mapping state of the buffer, see enums.BufferMapState.

returns.doc: None (awaitable); resolves when the buffer is mapped.

mode.doc: Whether to map for reading or writing, see flags.MapMode.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes of the range to map. Must be a multiple of 8. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The size in bytes of the range to map. Must be a multiple of 4. Defaults to the remainder of the buffer after offset.

map_async.doc:
Map (a part of) the buffer so its memory can be accessed by the CPU.

The returned promise or future resolves when the buffer is mapped. Once mapped, use get_mapped_range()
to access the data, and call unmap() when done to give the buffer back to the GPU.
Resolving only indicates that this buffer is mapped, not that other work has completed. However, when GPUQueue.on_submitted_work_done()
resolves, earlier map_async() calls on buffers last used exclusively on that queue have completed.

returns.doc: A writable memory view (e.g. a memoryview) on the mapped range.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes of the range, relative to the start of the buffer. Must be a multiple of 8. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The size in bytes of the range. Must be a multiple of 4. Defaults to the remainder of the mapped range after offset.

get_mapped_range.doc:
Get a view on the memory of a mapped part of the buffer.

The buffer must be mapped (see map_async() or the mapped_at_creation field of structs.BufferDescriptor).
The returned memory becomes invalid when the buffer is unmapped.

unmap.doc:
Unmap the buffer, making any mapped memory invalid, and handing the buffer back to the GPU.

If the buffer was mapped for writing, the written data becomes visible to the GPU.

destroy.doc:
Destroy the buffer and free its memory.

The buffer can no longer be used. Calling this multiple times is allowed.

GPUBuffer.doc:
A block of memory that can be used by the GPU for e.g. vertex data, uniform data or general storage.

Buffers are created with GPUDevice.create_buffer(). Data can be uploaded with GPUQueue.write_buffer() or
copy commands, or by mapping the buffer. Mapping makes the memory accessible to the CPU, but the
buffer cannot be used by the GPU while it is mapped.

width.doc: The width of the texture in texels.

height.doc: The height of the texture in texels.

depth_or_array_layers.doc: The depth (for 3D textures) or the number of array layers of the texture.

mip_level_count.doc: The number of mip levels of the texture.

sample_count.doc: The number of samples per pixel of the texture (1 unless multisampled).

dimension.doc: The dimensionality of the texture, see enums.TextureDimension.

format.doc: The pixel format of the texture, see enums.TextureFormat.

usage.doc: The allowed usages of the texture, a combination of flags.TextureUsage.

texture_binding_view_dimension.doc: Compatibility mode only: on devices without enums.FeatureName.core_features_and_limits, views of this texture must have this enums.TextureViewDimension. None on core devices.

descriptor.doc: A structs.TextureViewDescriptor. If omitted, a view of the whole texture is created.

create_view.doc:
Create a GPUTextureView, a specific view of (part of) the texture.

The view is what gets bound to shaders or used as a render attachment.

destroy.doc:
Destroy the texture and free its memory.

The texture can no longer be used. Calling this multiple times is allowed.

GPUTexture.doc:
An image resource of one, two or three dimensions, optionally with mip levels and array layers.

Textures are created with GPUDevice.create_texture(). To use a texture in a shader or as a render
attachment, create a GPUTextureView with create_view().

GPUTextureView.doc:
A view on (a part of) a GPUTexture.

Texture views are created with GPUTexture.create_view(), and are used in bind groups (see structs.BindGroupEntry)
and as render pass attachments (see structs.RenderPassColorAttachment).

GPUSampler.doc:
Defines how a texture is sampled in a shader: the filtering and the handling of coordinates outside of the texture.

Samplers are created with GPUDevice.create_sampler().

GPUBindGroupLayout.doc:
Describes the types of resources and their shader visibility for the bindings in a GPUBindGroup.

Bind group layouts are created with GPUDevice.create_bind_group_layout() or obtained from a pipeline
via GPUPipelineBase.get_bind_group_layout().

GPUBindGroup.doc:
A set of resources (buffers, samplers, texture views) bound together, following a GPUBindGroupLayout.

Bind groups are created with GPUDevice.create_bind_group() and activated with GPUBindingCommandsMixin.set_bind_group().

GPUPipelineLayout.doc:
Describes the bind group layouts (and immediate data size) that a pipeline uses.

Pipeline layouts are created with GPUDevice.create_pipeline_layout(), or derived automatically using enums.AutoLayoutMode.auto.

returns.doc: A GPUCompilationInfo (awaitable) with the list of messages.

get_compilation_info.doc:
Get diagnostic messages (errors, warnings, info) produced when compiling the shader.

The locations, order and contents of the messages are implementation-defined; in particular, they are not necessarily ordered by line number.

GPUShaderModule.doc:
