A compiled piece of shader code (WGSL), containing one or more entry points.

Shader modules are created with GPUDevice.create_shader_module() and used in pipeline descriptors (see structs.ProgrammableStage).

message.doc: The human-readable text of the message.

type.doc: The severity of the message, see enums.CompilationMessageType.

line_num.doc: The 1-based line number in the shader code that the message refers to, or 0 if it does not apply to a line.

line_pos.doc: The 1-based position in the line (in UTF-16 code units) that the message refers to, or 0 if it does not apply to a position.

offset.doc: The offset in the shader code (in UTF-16 code units) that the message refers to.

length.doc: The length (in UTF-16 code units) of the span in the shader code that the message refers to.

GPUCompilationMessage.doc:
A single diagnostic message produced when compiling a shader module.

The messages are available via the messages property of GPUCompilationInfo.

GPUCompilationInfo.doc:
The diagnostic messages produced when compiling a shader module.

Obtained from GPUShaderModule.get_compilation_info().

reason.doc: The reason for the failure, see enums.PipelineErrorReason.

options.doc: A structs.PipelineErrorInit with the reason of the error.

__init__.doc:
Create a GPUPipelineError.

Normally these are created by the implementation rather than by user code.

GPUPipelineError.doc:
The error that is raised when asynchronous pipeline creation fails.

Raised by GPUDevice.create_compute_pipeline_async() and GPUDevice.create_render_pipeline_async().

index.doc: The index of the bind group (the @group number in the shader).

get_bind_group_layout.doc:
Get the GPUBindGroupLayout of the pipeline for the given bind group index.

This is especially useful for pipelines created with enums.AutoLayoutMode.auto, where the layouts are derived from the shader.

GPUPipelineBase.doc:
The base class for GPUComputePipeline and GPURenderPipeline.

It provides access to the bind group layouts of the pipeline.

GPUComputePipeline.doc:
A pipeline that describes a compute shader and its resources.

Created with GPUDevice.create_compute_pipeline(). It is used in a compute pass with GPUComputePassEncoder.set_pipeline().

GPURenderPipeline.doc:
A pipeline that describes the complete graphics pipeline state: shaders, vertex layout, rasterization, depth/stencil and blending.

Created with GPUDevice.create_render_pipeline(). It is used in a render pass with GPURenderCommandsMixin.set_pipeline().

GPUCommandBuffer.doc:
A recorded list of GPU commands, ready to be submitted.

Obtained from GPUCommandEncoder.finish() and submitted with GPUQueue.submit(). A command buffer can only be submitted once.

GPUCommandsMixin.doc:
A mixin class for objects that record commands: GPUCommandEncoder, GPUComputePassEncoder, GPURenderPassEncoder and GPURenderBundleEncoder.

It has no methods of its own in the current version of the API.

descriptor.doc: A structs.RenderPassDescriptor describing the attachments of the pass.

begin_render_pass.doc:
Begin a render pass, returning a GPURenderPassEncoder to record draw commands with.

The pass must be ended with GPURenderPassEncoder.end() before the encoder can be used again.

descriptor.doc: A structs.ComputePassDescriptor. Optional.

begin_compute_pass.doc:
Begin a compute pass, returning a GPUComputePassEncoder to record dispatch commands with.

The pass must be ended with GPUComputePassEncoder.end() before the encoder can be used again.

source_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the source buffer where the copy starts.

destination_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the destination buffer where the data is written.

size.doc: The number of bytes to copy. Defaults to the size of the source buffer minus the source_offset argument of this method.

copy_buffer_to_buffer.doc:
Copy data from one GPUBuffer to another.

The source needs flags.BufferUsage.COPY_SRC and the destination flags.BufferUsage.COPY_DST.
Offsets and size must be multiples of 4, and the ranges must not overlap if the buffers are the same.

source.doc: A structs.TexelCopyBufferInfo describing the buffer and the layout of the data in it.

destination.doc: A structs.TexelCopyTextureInfo describing the part of the texture to copy to.

copy_size.doc: A structs.Extent3D (or tuple) with the size of the region to copy, in texels.

copy_buffer_to_texture.doc:
Copy data from a GPUBuffer to a GPUTexture.

The source buffer needs flags.BufferUsage.COPY_SRC and the texture flags.TextureUsage.COPY_DST.

source.doc: A structs.TexelCopyTextureInfo describing the part of the texture to copy from.

destination.doc: A structs.TexelCopyBufferInfo describing the buffer and the layout of the data in it.

copy_size.doc: A structs.Extent3D (or tuple) with the size of the region to copy, in texels.

copy_texture_to_buffer.doc:
Copy data from a GPUTexture to a GPUBuffer.

The texture needs flags.TextureUsage.COPY_SRC and the destination buffer flags.BufferUsage.COPY_DST.

source.doc: A structs.TexelCopyTextureInfo describing the part of the texture to copy from.

destination.doc: A structs.TexelCopyTextureInfo describing the part of the texture to copy to.

copy_size.doc: A structs.Extent3D (or tuple) with the size of the region to copy, in texels.

copy_texture_to_texture.doc:
Copy data from one GPUTexture to another.

The source needs flags.TextureUsage.COPY_SRC and the destination flags.TextureUsage.COPY_DST.
The formats must be compatible, and the sample counts equal.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes where the clearing starts. Must be a multiple of 4. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The number of bytes to clear. Must be a multiple of 4. Defaults to the remainder of the buffer after offset.

clear_buffer.doc:
Fill (a part of) a GPUBuffer with zeros.

The buffer needs flags.BufferUsage.COPY_DST.

query_set.doc: The GPUQuerySet to read results from.

first_query.doc: The index of the first query to resolve.

query_count.doc: The number of queries to resolve.

destination.doc: The GPUBuffer to write the results to.

destination_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the destination buffer where the results are written. Must be a multiple of 256.

resolve_query_set.doc:
Resolve the results of queries in a GPUQuerySet into a GPUBuffer.

The destination buffer needs flags.BufferUsage.QUERY_RESOLVE. Each result is written as a 64-bit unsigned integer.

descriptor.doc: A structs.CommandBufferDescriptor. Optional.

finish.doc:
Finish recording and return a GPUCommandBuffer.

The command buffer can be submitted with GPUQueue.submit(). The encoder cannot be used after this call.

GPUCommandEncoder.doc:
Records GPU commands (render passes, compute passes and copy operations) into a GPUCommandBuffer.

Create one with GPUDevice.create_command_encoder(). Call finish() to obtain the command buffer, and submit it with GPUQueue.submit().
Only one pass can be active at a time; end the pass (using the end() method of the pass encoder) before recording other commands.

index.doc: The index of the bind group (the @group number in the shader).

bind_group.doc: The GPUBindGroup to set, or None to unset it.

dynamic_offsets_data.doc: A list or array of offsets in bytes, one for each dynamic buffer binding, in order of binding number.

dynamic_offsets_data_start.doc: If dynamic_offsets_data is an array, the index of the first offset to use.

dynamic_offsets_data_length.doc: If dynamic_offsets_data is an array, the number of offsets to use.

set_bind_group.doc:
Set a GPUBindGroup for the given bind group index, to be used by subsequent draw or dispatch commands.

The bind group must be compatible with the layout of the pipeline. If the layout has entries with
dynamic offsets (see the has_dynamic_offset field of structs.BufferBindingLayout), offsets must be provided.
The dynamic offsets can be given as a list, or as a range of an array (using the start and length arguments).

range_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the immediate data range where the data is written. Must be a multiple of 4.

data.doc: The data to write, as an object that supports the buffer protocol (e.g. bytes or a numpy array).

data_offset.doc: The offset in the data (in elements of the data type, or bytes) where reading starts. Defaults to 0.

data_size.doc: The amount of data to write (in elements of the data type, or bytes). Defaults to the remainder of the data after data_offset.

set_immediates.doc:
Set immediate data: a small amount of data (typically a few hundred bytes at most) that is passed to shaders directly without a buffer.

The size of the immediate data is determined by the immediate_size field of structs.PipelineLayoutDescriptor.

GPUBindingCommandsMixin.doc:
A mixin class for pass encoders that can bind resources: GPUComputePassEncoder, GPURenderPassEncoder and GPURenderBundleEncoder.

It provides methods to set bind groups and immediate data.

group_label.doc: The label of the debug group.

push_debug_group.doc: Begin a labeled debug group. Every call must be matched with a call to pop_debug_group().

pop_debug_group.doc: End the most recent debug group that was started with push_debug_group().

insert_debug_marker.doc: Insert a single labeled marker into the command stream.

GPUDebugCommandsMixin.doc:
A mixin class for objects that record commands and support debug labeling: GPUCommandEncoder, GPUComputePassEncoder, GPURenderPassEncoder and GPURenderBundleEncoder.

Debug groups and markers show up in debugging tools and in error messages.

set_pipeline.doc: Set the GPUComputePipeline to use for subsequent dispatch commands.

workgroup_count_x.doc: The number of workgroups in the x dimension.

workgroup_count_y.doc: The number of workgroups in the y dimension. Defaults to 1.

workgroup_count_z.doc: The number of workgroups in the z dimension. Defaults to 1.

dispatch_workgroups.doc:
Run the compute shader of the current pipeline for a grid of workgroups.

The total number of invocations is the number of workgroups times the workgroup size defined in the shader.

indirect_buffer.doc: The GPUBuffer that contains the workgroup counts.

indirect_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the buffer where the counts start. Must be a multiple of 4.

dispatch_workgroups_indirect.doc:
Like dispatch_workgroups(), but the workgroup counts are read from a GPUBuffer.

The buffer must have flags.BufferUsage.INDIRECT, and contain three consecutive 32-bit unsigned integers (x, y, z) at the given offset.

end.doc: End the compute pass. The encoder can no longer be used afterwards.

GPUComputePassEncoder.doc:
Records the commands of a compute pass.

Created with GPUCommandEncoder.begin_compute_pass(). Set a pipeline and bind groups, dispatch work,
and finally call end(). Also has the methods of GPUBindingCommandsMixin and GPUDebugCommandsMixin.

x.doc: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the viewport, in pixels.

y.doc: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the viewport, in pixels.

width.doc: The width of the viewport, in pixels.

height.doc: The height of the viewport, in pixels.

min_depth.doc: The minimum depth value of the viewport (between 0 and 1).

max_depth.doc: The maximum depth value of the viewport (between 0 and 1).

set_viewport.doc:
Set the viewport: the region of the attachments that the clip-space output is mapped to.

Defaults to the full size of the attachments.

x.doc: The x coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle, in pixels.

y.doc: The y coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle, in pixels.

width.doc: The width of the rectangle, in pixels.

height.doc: The height of the rectangle, in pixels.

set_scissor_rect.doc:
Set the scissor rectangle: fragments outside of this rectangle are discarded.

Defaults to the full size of the attachments.

color.doc: The color, as a structs.Color or a tuple (r, g, b, a).

set_blend_constant.doc:
Set the blend constant color, used by blend factors enums.BlendFactor.constant and enums.BlendFactor.one_minus_constant.

Defaults to transparent black (0, 0, 0, 0).

reference.doc: The stencil reference value (an unsigned integer).

set_stencil_reference.doc:
Set the stencil reference value, used in stencil comparisons and by enums.StencilOperation.replace.

Defaults to 0.

query_index.doc: The index in the query set where the result is stored.

begin_occlusion_query.doc:
Begin an occlusion query, which counts the samples that pass the depth and stencil tests.

The result is stored in the occlusion_query_set of the pass (see structs.RenderPassDescriptor).
End the query with end_occlusion_query().

end_occlusion_query.doc: End the occlusion query that was started with begin_occlusion_query().

bundles.doc: A list of GPURenderBundle objects to execute, in order.

execute_bundles.doc:
Execute pre-recorded GPURenderBundle objects as part of this pass.

Bundles do not inherit the pipeline, bind groups or vertex/index buffers of the pass. After executing bundles (even zero of them),
that state is cleared, not restored, so it needs to be set again.

end.doc: End the render pass. The encoder can no longer be used afterwards.

GPURenderPassEncoder.doc:
Records the commands of a render pass.

Created with GPUCommandEncoder.begin_render_pass(). Set a pipeline, bind groups and vertex/index buffers,
draw, and finally call end(). Also has the methods of GPUBindingCommandsMixin, GPUDebugCommandsMixin and GPURenderCommandsMixin.

set_pipeline.doc: Set the GPURenderPipeline to use for subsequent draw commands.

buffer.doc: The GPUBuffer that contains the indices.

index_format.doc: The data type of the indices, see enums.IndexFormat.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the buffer where the indices start. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The size in bytes of the range to use. Defaults to the remainder of the buffer after offset.

set_index_buffer.doc:
Set the index buffer to use for subsequent indexed draw commands.

The buffer needs flags.BufferUsage.INDEX.

slot.doc: The index of the vertex buffer slot, matching the index in the buffers field of structs.VertexState.

buffer.doc: The GPUBuffer that contains the vertex data, or None to unset the slot.

offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the buffer where the vertex data starts. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The size in bytes of the range to use. Defaults to the remainder of the buffer after offset.

set_vertex_buffer.doc:
Set a vertex buffer for the given slot, to be used by subsequent draw commands.

The buffer needs flags.BufferUsage.VERTEX. The layout is defined by the buffers field of structs.VertexState.

vertex_count.doc: The number of vertices to draw.

instance_count.doc: The number of instances to draw. Defaults to 1.

first_vertex.doc: The index of the first vertex to draw (the offset into the vertex buffers, in vertices). Defaults to 0.

first_instance.doc: The instance index of the first instance to draw. Defaults to 0.

draw.doc: Draw primitives using the current pipeline and vertex buffers.

index_count.doc: The number of indices to draw.

instance_count.doc: The number of instances to draw. Defaults to 1.

first_index.doc: The position in the index buffer (in indices, not bytes) where drawing starts. Defaults to 0.

base_vertex.doc: A value added to each index before looking up the vertex. Defaults to 0.

first_instance.doc: The instance index of the first instance to draw. Defaults to 0.

draw_indexed.doc: Draw primitives using the current pipeline, vertex buffers and index buffer (see set_index_buffer()).

indirect_buffer.doc: The GPUBuffer that contains the draw parameters.

indirect_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the buffer where the parameters start. Must be a multiple of 4.

draw_indirect.doc:
Like draw(), but the parameters are read from a GPUBuffer.

The buffer must have flags.BufferUsage.INDIRECT, and contain a tightly packed block of four 32-bit unsigned integers (16 bytes)
at the given offset: vertex_count, instance_count, first_vertex and first_instance.
A non-zero first_instance requires enums.FeatureName.indirect_first_instance.

indirect_buffer.doc: The GPUBuffer that contains the draw parameters.

indirect_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the buffer where the parameters start. Must be a multiple of 4.

draw_indexed_indirect.doc:
Like draw_indexed(), but the parameters are read from a GPUBuffer.

The buffer must have flags.BufferUsage.INDIRECT, and contain a tightly packed block of five 32-bit values (20 bytes) at the given offset:
index_count, instance_count, first_index, base_vertex and first_instance.
A non-zero first_instance requires enums.FeatureName.indirect_first_instance.

GPURenderCommandsMixin.doc:
A mixin class for objects that record render commands: GPURenderPassEncoder and GPURenderBundleEncoder.

It provides methods to set the pipeline, vertex and index buffers, and to draw.

GPURenderBundle.doc:
A pre-recorded sequence of render commands that can be executed in render passes.

Obtained from GPURenderBundleEncoder.finish() and executed with GPURenderPassEncoder.execute_bundles().

descriptor.doc: A structs.RenderBundleDescriptor. Optional.

finish.doc:
Finish recording and return a GPURenderBundle.

The encoder cannot be used after this call.

GPURenderBundleEncoder.doc:
Records render commands into a GPURenderBundle, which can be replayed in multiple render passes.

Created with GPUDevice.create_render_bundle_encoder(). Also has the methods of GPUBindingCommandsMixin,
GPUDebugCommandsMixin and GPURenderCommandsMixin.

command_buffers.doc: A list of GPUCommandBuffer objects, executed in order.

submit.doc:
Submit a list of command buffers for execution on the GPU.

Each command buffer can only be submitted once.

returns.doc: None (awaitable); resolves when the submitted work is done.

on_submitted_work_done.doc:
Wait until all work that was submitted so far has been completed by the GPU.

Resolving also implies completion of earlier GPUBuffer.map_async() calls on buffers last used exclusively on this queue.

buffer_offset.doc: The offset in bytes in the buffer where the data is written.

data.doc: The data to write, as an object that supports the buffer protocol (e.g. bytes or a numpy array).

data_offset.doc: The offset in the data (in elements of the data type, or bytes) where reading starts. Defaults to 0.

size.doc: The amount of data to write (in elements of the data type, or bytes). Defaults to the remainder of the data after data_offset.

write_buffer.doc:
Write data to a GPUBuffer.

This is a convenient way to upload data. The buffer needs flags.BufferUsage.COPY_DST.
The size of the data to write and the offset must be multiples of 4.

destination.doc: A structs.TexelCopyTextureInfo describing the part of the texture to write to.

data.doc: The data to write, as an object that supports the buffer protocol (e.g. bytes or a numpy array).

data_layout.doc: A structs.TexelCopyBufferLayout describing the layout of the texel data in data.

size.doc: A structs.Extent3D (or tuple) with the size of the region to write, in texels.

write_texture.doc:
Write data to a GPUTexture.

This is a convenient way to upload texture data. The texture needs flags.TextureUsage.COPY_DST.

GPUQueue.doc:
The queue on which work is submitted to the GPU.

Each GPUDevice has a default queue, available via the queue property of GPUDevice.
It is used to submit command buffers and to upload data to buffers and textures.

type.doc: The type of queries in the set, see enums.QueryType.

count.doc: The number of queries in the set.

destroy.doc:
Destroy the query set and free its resources.

The query set can no longer be used. Calling this multiple times is allowed.

GPUQuerySet.doc:
A set of queries that hold results such as occlusion counts or timestamps.

Created with GPUDevice.create_query_set(). Results are written during passes and can be read by resolving
them into a buffer with GPUCommandEncoder.resolve_query_set().

canvas.doc: The canvas (or window/surface object) that this context belongs to.

configuration.doc: A structs.CanvasConfiguration with the device, format and other settings.

configure.doc:
Configure the context for use with a device, so that textures can be obtained from it.

Calling this again replaces the previous configuration. It also clears the drawing buffer to transparent black.
Use get_configuration() to detect support for optional configuration members.

unconfigure.doc:
Remove the configuration and destroy any textures produced while configured.

After this, get_current_texture() cannot be used until the context is configured again.

returns.doc: The structs.CanvasConfiguration that was last passed to configure(), or None if the context is not configured.

get_configuration.doc:
Get the current configuration of the context, or None if it is not configured.

This is mainly useful for feature detection of optional members of structs.CanvasConfiguration; for supported members it returns the originally supplied values.

get_current_texture.doc:
Get the GPUTexture to render to for the current frame.

The texture has the size of the canvas, and is the texture that will be composited to the canvas next. The same GPUTexture object is returned
until the frame is presented (even if it was destroyed or failed validation); a new one is returned for the next frame.

GPUCanvasContext.doc:
The connection between a canvas (or window) and the GPU, used to present rendered images.

Configure it with configure(), then each frame obtain a texture with get_current_texture(),
render to it, and submit the work. The result is presented when the frame ends.

reason.doc: The reason the device was lost, see enums.DeviceLostReason.

message.doc: A human-readable message with details about why the device was lost.

GPUDeviceLostInfo.doc:
Information about why a GPUDevice was lost.

Available via the lost property of GPUDevice.

message.doc: A human-readable description of the error, meant for developers (debugging, bug reports) and not for end users. Do not try to parse it.

GPUError.doc:
The base class of errors that are generated by the GPU API.

Subclasses are GPUValidationError, GPUOutOfMemoryError and GPUInternalError.
Errors are obtained via error scopes (see GPUDevice.push_error_scope()) or the onuncapturederror property of GPUDevice.

__init__.doc:
Create a GPUValidationError.

Normally these are created by the implementation rather than by user code.

GPUValidationError.doc:
An error that signals that an operation did not satisfy the validation rules of the API, i.e. incorrect usage.

Captured by error scopes with enums.ErrorFilter.validation.

__init__.doc:
Create a GPUOutOfMemoryError.

Normally these are created by the implementation rather than by user code.

GPUOutOfMemoryError.doc:
An error that signals that there was not enough memory to complete an operation.

Captured by error scopes with enums.ErrorFilter.out_of_memory.

__init__.doc:
Create a GPUInternalError.

Normally these are created by the implementation rather than by user code.

GPUInternalError.doc:
An error that signals that an operation failed for a reason that is not caused by incorrect usage, e.g. an implementation-specific limit.

Captured by error scopes with enums.ErrorFilter.internal.
